title: Glasshouse
description: Layered botanical silhouettes shift at different depths behind a glass pane.
useCase: Create a contained dimensional image for a botanical, architectural or material showcase.
interaction: Move across the specimen or adjust depth
reducedMotion: Reduced motion disables pointer parallax. The depth range changes a meaningful static pose immediately for keyboard and touch users.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Sage-green page with a deep green-framed glass case holding three overlapping translucent fern silhouettes, a diagonal glass glare and a depth slider below.
motion: Moving the mouse shifts three fern layers by increasing amounts toward the pointer with a 300 ms ease-out; leaving returns a rest pose, and the slider scales the depth.
adapt: Mouse-only `onPointerMove` sets `point`; each fern `g` translates by `point` × `depth` scaled per layer, with a fixed rotation and 300 ms transition. Replace the three fern layers with your artwork; tune `depth` and the resting `point`.
